newsitem.title: EGYPT: U.S. envoy leaves Egypt to continue peace quest.
newsitem.headline: U.S. envoy leaves Egypt to continue peace quest.

text.p: U.S. envoy Dennis Ross left Egypt on Saturday after talks with Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak on the stalled Middle East peace process.

Airport officials in Sharm el-Sheikh told Reuters by telephone that Ross left the Red Sea resort town, where he and Mubarak held talks as part of Ross's tour to try to revive peace between Palestinians and Israelis.
Ross was due to return to Israel and Palestinian self-rule areas after his talks with Mubarak.

Ross had said the talks were a chance to present his efforts to end the two-month deadlock, triggered by Israel's start in March of a Jewish settlement in Jerusalem. Egyptian officials said it was premature to speak of any breakthrough.
